subtopics.title: Avogadro's Law and the 22,4 That Fits Every Gas

questions.question: Avogadro's law states that equal volumes of gases at the same temperature and pressure contain:
options: Equal numbers of molecules, whatever the gas
Equal numbers of atoms only for the same gas

questions.question: STP means:
One mole of ANY gas at STP occupies:
options: A volume depending on its molar mass

questions.question: Heavy and light gas molecules fill the same molar volume because:
options: The balance reads them the same
A gas is mostly empty space — the spacing, set by temperature and pressure, fixes the volume

subtopics.title: From 13 Grams of Solid to Litres of Gas

questions.question: In Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl2 + H2 with the acid in excess, the calculation must be based on:
options: The zinc — the reactant that limits the amounts
The acid — there is more of it

questions.question: 13 g of zinc (M = 65 g/mol) is:
The volume of hydrogen produced at STP is:
Had the question asked for the MASS of hydrogen instead, the answer would be:

subtopics.title: Volume Ratios — Stoichiometry Without a Balance

questions.question: For gases at the same temperature and pressure, the mole ratio equals the volume ratio because:
options: Equal volumes hold equal molecule counts, so volumes count molecules
All gases have the same molar mass
Volume and mass are the same for gases

questions.question: In 2CO + O2 → 2CO2, 20 dm³ of CO requires and produces:
options: 20 dm³ of O2 and 40 dm³ of CO2
10 dm³ of O2 and 20 dm³ of CO2
5 dm³ of O2 and 10 dm³ of CO2
40 dm³ of O2 and 20 dm³ of CO2

questions.question: The 30 dm³ of reactant gases becoming 20 dm³ of product shows that:
options: Volume follows molecule count — three molecules became two, so the volume shrank while mass balanced

questions.question: The volume-ratio shortcut applies to:
options: Every substance in the equation, including solids
Only the species marked (g), all at the same shared conditions

subtopics.title: The Gas Toolkit, the Traps, and Where This Leads

questions.question: Using 22,4 dm³/mol is only licensed when:
options: The gas is at STP — otherwise state the assumption or use the given data
The gas is lighter than air
The volume is wanted in litres

questions.question: One mole of LIQUID water occupies about:
options: 18 cm³ — the 22,4 is a gas-only privilege

questions.question: 560 cm³ of gas, before entering any formula, becomes:
In Grade 11, the STP shortcut is replaced by:
options: The ideal gas equation, which prices a gas at any temperature and pressure

questions.question: The courier-crate picture works because gases, like the courier, pack by:
options: Count — equal volumes hold equal numbers of molecules
Mass — heavier cargo gets bigger crates

questions.question: One mole of hydrogen and one mole of carbon dioxide at STP fill:
options: Volumes proportional to their molar masses
The same 22,4 litres each — the crate ignores the cargo

questions.question: 5,6 litres of any gas collected at STP is:
options: A quarter of a mole — a quarter of a crate
Impossible to interpret without the gas's identity

questions.question: Litres of gas at STP become moles by:

subtopics.title: A Spoonful of Zinc, a Balloon of Gas

questions.question: 'Plenty of acid' tells you that:
options: The acid is in excess, so the zinc alone dictates the amounts
More gas will form than the zinc allows

questions.question: 13 grams of zinc is a fifth of a mole because:
options: One mole of zinc weighs 65 grams, and 13/65 = 0,2
The acid divides it by five

questions.question: Packing the crates, a fifth of a mole of hydrogen at STP fills:
A gas answer of a few cubic centimetres from grams of reacting solid should make you:
options: Convert it to litres and accept it
Suspect the arithmetic — gases are roomy, and spacious answers are normal

questions.question: The coefficients of an all-gas equation at shared conditions can be read directly as:
options: The volume recipe — cups of ingredients and blend

questions.question: In the carbon monoxide recipe, 30 litres in became 20 litres out because:
options: Three reactant molecules became two product molecules — volume follows the count
The product is denser than air

questions.question: The volume-recipe shortcut requires the gases to be:
options: At the same conditions as each other — any shared crate size cancels

questions.question: A solid or liquid appearing in the equation:
options: Adds its own 22,4 to the total
Must be converted to litres first
Contributes no volume to the recipe — only species marked (g) ride
